title: Waiting or Acting: The Effects of Environmental Regulatory Uncertainty on Green Innovation
eligible_reason: Main design is continuous: first-differenced green patents on d.lncpu (climate policy uncertainty), instrumented with House polarization (ivreghdfe). The DiD (Table 5 and an R&D table) uses the 2018 Affordable Clean Energy rule: post_ace = fyear 2019-2020 vs 2014-2017 for all firms x treated_fossil (fossil-fuel power producers), a single common date, with lagged time-varying firm controls (l.size, l.roa, l.leverage, etc.). Not staggered.
design_notes: Stata (data built in SAS/Stata). Compustat firm-year panel with patents, R&D, EPA GHG and TRI emissions. Firm regressions: reghdfe/ivreghdfe on first differences with gvkey/fyear or gvkey_fyear FE. ACE DiD: reghdfe y_std i.post_ace##i.treated_fossil $lcontrol, absorb(gvkey1 fyear), event-study version with ace_m4..ace_p2 x treated_fossil (2018 omitted). Table A6 plant-level emissions.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: ACE rule proposal (2018) common to all treated fossil-fuel firms.

specs.exclusion_reason: common treatment date (ACE rule 2018); lagged time-varying firm controls
specs.code_file: 03 Table do files/2 Table 5 GHG ACE Rule code.do
specs.controls: l.lnrg_sent_ew_std l.size_std l.lnage_std l.mtb_std l.roa_std l.capex_std l.rd_std l.tangibility_std l.leverage_std l.cf_std

data_files: 02 Reg_sample data/Compressed stata datasets.zip (funda_firm_pat.dta, Table 5 GHG ACE rule reg.dta, funda_plant.dta)
data_files_note: Regression-ready .dta files shipped (include WRDS/Compustat fields); raw EPA TRI files and intermediate data also included.
software_notes: reghdfe, ivreghdfe, ppmlhdfe; SAS for raw data.
screener_notes: Data shipped but no staggered design (IV main; common-date DiD supporting).
